Known for clean and euphonious mixing
A soundship anchored by world bass and global club that could sail freaky in the winds of 
R&B, trap and wave. 
Organic, deep, and Afro house.
Amapiano, reggaeton and dancehall.
weeks.bio:
Bex’s spaceholding reflects her deep enthusiasm for articulating the
underlying patterns of nondual philosophy through the laboratory of
embodied research — in other words, moving and breathing together.
She’s here to remind you: this body is your home, your teacher, your
portal. And yes, you’re meant to feel whole through it. Free your ass
and your mind will follow!
weeks.name: Dj Bex Naj
weeks.somaticBlurb:
Acro-Contact Fusion
Come explore the playful space where acro yoga meets contact improv. We’ll learn beginner-friendly acro yoga poses, then explore how to transition in and out of them safely and with ease. Next we’ll weave the poses into contact improv, discovering how acro can naturally emerge within a dance. We’ll also practice inviting each other into acro poses, recognizing a “yes” or “no” through movement, and keeping the dance flowing either way. Come ready to connect, get playful, and discover new ways of moving together.

weeks.bio:
NEW DATE, WEDS NOV 25TH Faren Rajkumar AKA Mother Void is a nomadic musician & muse of West Indian ancestry, currently based in the PNW. she celebrates her culture & the Matriarchy through musical expression and commanding the dancefloor.

Mother Void is a classically trained violinist offering DJ sets w/ live violin, acoustic instrumentals, and private instruction. she has been playing violin for over 25 years, and recently developed mixing skills to combine electronic and acoustic sounds for dance.

as a dance journey facilitator/DJ, Mother Void invites bodies to contemplate their inner dark matter and creation center, conjure movement medicine and experience the sacred sensations of sound, vibration, motion, touch and stillness. she is an expert at creating complete dance arc journeys that can take you through the five rhythms, induce powerful awakening & release of suppressed sensual energy, or inspire play with others on the dance floor.

weeks.bio:
Apukuna is known for creating immersive, genre-blending journeys that ignite dance floors and
ecstatic dances, guide ambient sound journeys, and deepen breathwork sessions.
His approach is distinctly live and improvisational. Through looping, live remixing, vocals, and
percussion, he shapes each set in real time—blurring the line between DJ and live performance.
Rooted in both global and contemporary sounds, Apukuna artfully merges heart-centered
frequencies with soul-shaking movement. He describes his sonic creations as “a movement, a
meditation, and a prayer for an awakening heart”.
Apukuna is a regular contributor to ecstatic dances across Canada and the USA and has
performed and facilitated at gatherings internationally, including BOOM Festival (Portugal),
Dreamersland (Poland), Ecstatic Dance Festival (Cyprus), Connexion Extatique (Canada), Rise
Wellness Festival (Canada), Beyond Music & Arts Festival (Turkey), Wicked Woods Music
Festival (Canada), Sonic Springs (Canada) and Burning Man (USA).
On SoundCloud, his mixes attract a global following. His “Return of the Bird Tribes” journey is a
steady favorite along with mixes produced for Jumpsuit Records, NUMA, Baikal Nomads,
Echoes from Venus, Ritmos del Sur and Cosmovision Records
weeks.name: Dj Apukuna
